_comment: Countries the Live data tab lists, and how each one is reached. A country with no `connector` is still checked for files in data/live/<code>/ — drop a CSV, Excel, JSON, text or HTML file there and it counts as connected. An `http` connector is fetched on demand; put secrets in environment variables and name them here (url_env, headers_env), never the values. Codes are UN M49 / Comtrade codes, so they line up with the mirror partners.
_examples_comment: Shown only in the Live data tab's Example mode, read from samples/live/<code>/. Example data, never real.
